claims.statement: Secondary reporting says the bank disclosed an attack that allowed fraudulent transactions, with the attacker reaching its network through a service provider's platform.
As cited from the bank's 4 November 2026 release, the incident was contained, customer assets were not affected and some transfers were delayed.
A loss of about $133 million comes from an independent on-chain investigator; the bank has not confirmed that figure.
